data.title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Warum diese Rolle?

GovRadar ist eine cloudbasierte Software zur automatisierten Erstellung öffentlicher Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Lösung sparen Behörden bis zu 90% Zeit in der Vergabevorbereitung, damit Investitionen schneller in die Umsetzung kommen.

Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.


Deine Mission

Als (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager bist du die treibende Kraft zur zielgerichteten Erweiterung unseres Teams und spielst damit eine entscheidende Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum. Du bist Teil des CEO Office und für Kandidaten, wie auch unsere Hiring Manager, die zentrale Ansprechperson im gesamten Recruiting Prozess.
Für diese Herausforderungen brauchen wir dich:

  • Verantwortung des end-to-end Recruiting-Prozesses, von Hiring Strategie über Stellenausschreibung und Pipeline Management bis zur Vertragsunterschrift
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Branding, um GovRadar zur ersten Wahl für Top-Talente im GovTech-Sektor zu etablieren
  • Active Sourcing und Aufbau qualifizierter Talent-Pipelines für verschiedene Rollen in Product & Engineering, GTM und Operations
  • Sicherstellung einer effizienten und wertschätzenden Experience für Kandidaten und Hiring Manager
  • Koordinierung von externen Stakeholdern, wie z.B. Headhunter für ausgewählte Positionen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von skalierbaren Prozessen mit dem richtigen Mix aus AI/Automatisierung und Human Touch


Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level
  • Umgang mit Tech- & Business-Profilen: du bist nachweislich in der Lage, Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichsten Backgrounds zu begeistern, zu qualifizieren und mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Spaß am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld: du hast bereits in einem Startup gearbeitet und siehst schnelle Veränderungen und fehlende Strukturen als spannende Herausforderung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, nimmst proaktiv Herausforderungen an und holst dir an den entsprechenden Stellen Unterstützung dazu
  • Daten- und Tech-Affinität: du steuerst deine Pipeline datengetrieben und suchst proaktiv nach Potentialen für Automatisierung/AI
  • Aufbau von Strukturen: du hast skalierbare Prozesse nicht nur angewendet, sondern bereits selbst von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung mitgestaltet
Nice to have’s
  • Talent Acquisition als neue Funktion von Grund auf aufgebaut & etabliert
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Teamtailor als ATS
  • Vernetzung im Münchner SaaS-Startup-Ökosystem
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem öffentlichen Sektor oder GovTech-Unternehmen


Was dich erwartet

  • Team & Kultur - ein hochmotiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Ownership - ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, eine neue Funktion nach deinen Ideen und Vorstellungen aufzubauen
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung - ein attraktives Fixgehalt zuzüglich performance-basierter Boni, die deine Erfolge belohnen
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen - Weiterentwicklung als Teil deiner individuellen Ziele, unterstützt durch dezidiertes Budget und monatliches Coaching mit deiner Führungskraft
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrides Modell (3 Tage im Büro direkt am Hauptbahnhof), flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit auf Workation
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit - du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Leadership Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact - trage aktiv dazu bei, den Staat in Deutschland handlungsfähiger zu machen und das Vertrauen der Menschen in die Demokratie zu stärken

data.title: Senior Account Manager (all genders)
data.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams im Großraum Hamburg.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Als Senior Account Manager - Infrastruktur & Services (all genders) identifizierst und erschließt du Geschäftspotenziale bei Neu- und Bestandskunden im Großraum Hamburg. Du entwickelst Vertriebsstrategien, verantwortest Angebote und Vertragsverhandlungen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Mit deinem Marktverständnis platzierst du unser Portfolio gezielt und trägst aktiv zum Unternehmenserfolg bei.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest den Vertrieb von Infrastruktur- und Service-Lösungen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden im Public Sector, speziell bei IT-Dienstleistern in Norddeutschland 
  • Du identifizierst Geschäftspotenziale, baust belastbare Kundenbeziehungen auf und erreichst die vereinbarten Vertriebsziele
  • Du steuerst Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozesse ganzheitlich, von der Bid-Strategie über die Kalkulation bis zur Präsentation beim Kunden
  • Du führst proaktive Vertriebs- und Kundenkampagnen durch und platzierst unser Portfolio gezielt bei relevanten Entscheidungsträgern
  • Du bereitest Kundentermine vor Ort und remote vor, führst diese eigenständig durch und überführst identifizierte Bedarfe in konkrete Verkaufschancen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Bid Management, PreSales, Delivery und externen Partnern zusammen, um optimale Kundenlösungen zu entwickeln
  • Du dokumentierst Vertriebsaktivitäten im CRM, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und berichtest regelmäßig zu deinen Accounts und Opportunities


Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Sales, Account Management oder in einer vergleichbaren vertriebsnahen Funktion
  • Du kannst nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge vorweisen und hast Freude daran, neue Geschäftspotenziale zu identifizieren und auszubauen
  • Du kennst den Public Sector in Norddeutschland, idealerweise mit Kontakten im Bereich der öffentlichen IT-Dienstleistern
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse im Vertrieb von Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur sowie ein gutes Verständnis für den Betrieb von Rechenzentren mit
  • Du kennst die aktuellen Digitalisierungsthemen und Entwicklungen im Public Sector und kannst diese in Kundengesprächen adressieren
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren und Ausschreibungen und bewegst dich sicher im Umfeld des öffentlichen Einkaufs
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit, in unserem Office in Hamburg oder vor Ort beim Kunden.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
  
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

data.description:
Hi, wir sind Doonails! 💅🏼

Ein schnell wachsendes Beauty-Startup, das die Manikürewelt revolutioniert. Mit innovativen Produkten, einer starken Community und Präsenz im Online-Shop sowie bei führenden Retail-Partnern bringen wir Studio-Qualität direkt nach Hause, einfach, schnell und stilvoll.

einen Senior Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) mit E-Commerce-Power und echter Leidenschaft für die Beauty-Branche.

data.title: Nix / NixOS Software Engineering Intern
data.description:
atvari is a technology company specializing in software and cloud architecture, custom software engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, and IT consulting. The team is passionate about building robust, modern solutions with a strong focus on Rust, Nix, and open-source technologies. atvari values clean, maintainable code and collaborative engineering practices. Applicants can expect to work in an environment that encourages learning, experimentation, and contribution to the open-source community.

Tasks

Role Description

As a Nix / NixOS Software Engineering Intern at atvari, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of Nix-based development and deployment environments. You will assist in writing and refining Nix and NixOS configurations, automating build and deployment workflows, and integrating Nix with existing software projects. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with engineers on backend services, troubleshooting environment and dependency issues, and documenting configuration and tooling. This is a fully remote internship, where you will work closely with the engineering team and gain hands-on experience with Rust, Nix, and cloud-native practices.

Internship Details

This is an unpaid internship for the duration of 1-3 months based on your needs. It is either offered as a voluntary internship (Freiwilliges Praktikum) or a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) and it is only available to German residents.

You are eligible if one of these conditions apply to you:

  • you do not have a completed apprenticeship or university degree (Freiwilliges Praktikum)
  • you need a mandatory internship as part of a degree program (Pflichtpraktikum)

Requirements

  • Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.
  • Exposure to Software Development and Programming, with experience in at least one high-level language (Rust experience is a plus).
  • Understanding of Back-End Web Development concepts, such as APIs, microservices, and server-side frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Functional Programming (FP) principles and their practical application in codebases.
  • Interest in Nix / NixOS, reproducible builds, DevOps, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to learn quickly, work in a team setting, and communicate clearly about technical topics.
  • Comfort working remotely in Germany and collaborating in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Benefits

Our Tech Stack

  • OpenTofu / Terraform

data.title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
data.description:
Über tonies:

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.
Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.


Du als Teil von tonies:

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben.
Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten.
Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

IT-Strategie & Architektur

  • Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit.
  • Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce).
  • Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX.
IT-Governance & Sicherheit
  • Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal).
  • Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.).
  • Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans.
  • Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende.
  • Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen.


Was wir uns von dir wünschen:

  • Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich).
  • Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards.
  • Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“.
  • Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365).
  • Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
  • Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten.
  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus).


Warum tonies?

Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. data.title: Principal Product Manager - E-commerce (all genders)
data.description:
About tonies:

tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries.

Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

Are you passionate about bringing interactive edutainment to kids across the world? We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Ecommerce to lead the evolution of our global digital commerce platforms. 

The Mission
Your mission is to own and evolve the global digital commerce platforms to enable scalable, performant, and business-aligned commerce experiences. You will act as the strategic anchor for the shopping experience, ensuring our platform investments align with global business priorities while balancing operational efficiency with scalability. Success is measured by delivering commercial growth, improving conversion rates, and optimizing platform efficiency, experimentation velocity, and stakeholder satisfaction.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Strategic Direction & Platform Ownership

  • Lead the Vision: Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for our global e-commerce platforms, ensuring a unified shopping experience across all markets.
  • Architecture Governance: Partner closely with Engineering to govern architecture decisions during and post-migration, ensuring a robust foundation for 2026+.
  • Vendor Management: Own strategic relationships and manage software vendors and tools used across the platform (e.g., payment processing, CMS) to maximize value and performance.
  • Business Alignment: Align platform investments with global and local business priorities, driving cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams.
Execution & Operational Excellence
  • Drive Execution: Own the execution of key initiatives within a cross-functional team, continuously prioritizing opportunities to maintain a competitive roadmap.
  • Global Consistency: Ensure 100% parity of core shopping flows (product pages, checkout) across major regions and drive cross-market consistency.
  • Continuous Discovery: Drive continuous discovery for future evolutions, validating new concepts with a "customer-centric" approach.
  • Mentorship: Act as a senior mentor to Product Managers (e.g., Checkout, Landing & Merch), fostering a culture of product excellence, innovation, and collaboration


What we are looking for:

  • Visionary & Experienced: You have at least 7+ years of product management experience in e-commerce, with a track record of leading complex platform strategies.
  • Technical Fluency: You are fluent in e-commerce and marketing technology (Shopify, Commercetools, etc.) and can confidently own the technology stack.
  • Strategic & Operational: You can balance rapid growth across markets with improving the existing 'glocal' experience.
  • Data-Driven: You love data and use it to evangelize quality insights, defining success metrics that drive fast build-and-learn cycles.
  • Leadership: You are a clear communicator with high empathy. You have already mentored or led a team and have the ambition to lead teams in the future.


Why tonies?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world.
  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best.
  • Mobility: Choose the option that suits you best - a Deutschlandticket (public transport ticket) for unlimited mobility, a monthly contribution for an office parking space, a leasing bicycle, or a remote work subsidy.
  • Enhanced Security: Benefit from subsidies for company pension plans, occupational pension schemes, and occupational disability insurance.
  • Rest & Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave as well as three additional days off such as Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also use up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave days).
  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.
  • Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.
  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products.


Good to know:

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies®. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

data.title: Panel Manager (f/m/d) - Freelancer / Contractor; 100% remote possible
data.description:
Panel Manager (f/m/d)

📍 Location: Remote (No Relocation)
💼 Employment Type: Contractor / Freelance ; 3 to 6 months contract

About PlaytestCloud

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can. 

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing. 

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Get in touch with us

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? 

Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. 

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Als Werkstudent/in im Vertrieb übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung im direkten Kundenkontakt und sorgst für reibungslose interne Prozesse:

  • Lead-Vorqualifizierung: Du übernimmst den Erstkontakt zu potenziellen Neukunden, qualifizierst Anfragen vor und filterst relevante Leads für unsere Energie-Experten im Sales-Team

  • Informationsbeschaffung: Du bist hartnäckig, aber charmant, wenn es darum geht, fehlende Dokumente oder wichtige Fotos (z. B. vom Zählerschrank, Hausdach oder Heizungskeller) von Kunden rechtzeitig einzuholen
  • Prozessoptimierung (Sales to Ops): Du stellst sicher, dass alle relevanten Kundeninformationen und technischen Details vollständig vorliegen, um eine saubere und schnelle Übergabe vom Vertrieb an unsere Installations-Teams (Ops) zu garantieren.


Dein Profil

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur abarbeitet, sondern jemanden, der mitdenkt und anpackt. Folgende Punkte sind uns wichtig:

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du hast großen Spaß am Telefonieren, bist redegewandt, schlagfertig und triffst im Kundenkontakt stets den richtigen Ton

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du durchdringst Problemstellungen in Sekundenschnelle und weißt genau, welche Informationen das Ops-Team für die reibungslose Installation der Energiesysteme benötigt

  • Zielorientierung & Drive: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlierst das Ziel nie aus den Augen und hakst proaktiv nach, bis alle Unterlagen vollständig sind

  • Studentischer Status: Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert (der Studiengang ist zweitrangig, wichtig ist deine Motivation)

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte (Nice-to-have):

  •  Passion for Impact: Du brennst für die Themen Klimaschutz, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeit

  •  Branchenwissen: Du hast bereits erste Berührungspunkte oder Vorwissen im Bereich Wärmepumpen, Photovoltaik oder Energiemanagement gesammelt (Kein Muss – wir bringen dir das Wichtigste bei, aber es hilft dir beim Start enorm!)



Benefits

  • Start-up-Spirit & Professionalität: Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, direkten Entscheidungswegen und einem hochmotivierten Team

data.title: Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) Voll- oder Teilzeit, Böblingen (hybrid)
data.description:
Worum es geht

  • Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit und in Teilzeit (ab 25 Std./Woche) besetzbar.

  • Du bringst Ordnung in die Buchhaltung von Thorit – und baust die Strukturen, mit denen sie mitwächst.

  • Wir sind in den letzten Jahren deutlich gewachsen, die Finanzprozesse sind dabei nicht im gleichen Tempo mitgekommen. Es gibt keinen dokumentierten Monatsabschluss, die offenen Posten sind nicht durchgängig gepflegt, vieles hängt an einzelnen Personen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe: nicht ein bestehendes System verwalten, sondern eines aufbauen.

  • Du arbeitest dabei nicht allein. Die laufende Buchhaltung läuft über unsere Steuerkanzlei, für die vorbereitende Buchhaltung wirst du intern durch die Assistenz unterstützt. Du bist die Person, die das Ganze steuert, qualitätssichert und in geordnete Bahnen bringt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest Debitoren-, Kreditoren- und Sachkontenbuchhaltung inklusive Bankabstimmung – in der Steuerung gemeinsam mit unserer Kanzlei und der internen vorbereitenden Buchhaltung

  • Du baust einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Monatsabschlussprozess auf, den es heute so nicht gibt

  • Du räumst die Altbestände in Debitoren und Kreditoren auf und hältst die OPOS-Listen (offene Posten) aktuell

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen korrekt und fristgerecht rausgehen

  • Du begleitest den Jahresabschluss in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Steuerberater

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Reisekosten korrekt abgerechnet werden

  • Du dokumentierst die Finance-Prozesse in Confluence, damit sie nicht an einzelnen Köpfen hängen

Das bringst du mit

Notwendig

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der deutschen Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV

  • Fundiertes Grundwissen im deutschen Handels- und Steuerrecht, soweit es die Buchhaltung betrifft

  • Lust darauf, eigenständig zu arbeiten und Struktur aufzubauen, ohne enge Führung im Tagesgeschäft

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) und solides Business-Englisch

Schön zu haben

  • Erfahrung in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung sowie mit DEÜV/ELStAM/DATEV Lohn + Gehalt – die Abrechnung läuft aktuell extern, wäre aber perspektivisch ein Thema

  • Erfahrung in der Begleitung von Jahresabschlüssen mit einer externen Kanzlei

  • Erfahrung in einem wachsenden Unternehmen oder einer Beratung

Unser Setup

Damit du weißt, worauf du dich einlässt:

  • WeClapp ist unser führendes System – hier laufen Rechnungsausgang, Eingangsrechnungen und OPOS zusammen

  • DATEV (Kanzlei-Rechnungswesen, Zahlungsverkehr) für die Buchhaltung in Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Steuerkanzlei

  • Qonto für Kontoanbindung und Belegmatching mit DATEV-Schnittstelle

  • TravelPerk für Reisebuchungen

  • Confluence für Prozessdokumentation, Forecast.it für Zeiterfassung, HubSpot als CRM

  • Claude AI ist bei uns Standardwerkzeug – nicht, um Buchhaltung zu ersetzen, sondern um dir Recherche, Dokumentation und wiederkehrende Fleißarbeit abzunehmen

Was wir dir zusagen

  • Alle Zugriffe ab Tag 1: Bankvollmachten, System- und Leserechte, die du für deine Arbeit brauchst – ohne dass du ihnen hinterherlaufen musst

  • Feste Ansprechpartner: unser COO für das Tagesgeschäft, unser Steuerberater für fachliche Fragen, unser CFO-Berater für den Aufbau der Prozesse

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an unseren CEO und bist Teil des internen Teams, das Thorit am Laufen hält

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Standort: Böblingen, hybrid – 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro

  • Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 25 Std./Woche

  • Start: ab sofort

Was wir bieten

  • Vorsorge & Zuschüsse: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über die Allianz mit gestaffeltem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 50 bis 290 € monatlich, dazu Lunchit-Essenszuschuss von bis zu 100 € monatlich

  • Flexibilität: Bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr Arbeiten von überall in der EU inklusive 500 € Zuschuss, Spaces-Coworking-Mitgliedschaft, flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Business Bike Leasing, Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu über 8.000 Standorten

  • Weiterbildung: Vollzugriff auf die Blinkist-Business-Bibliothek (4.500+ Titel), 3 Monate Babbel, vollständig finanzierte HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Kultur: Flache Hierarchien mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung, moderner Toolstack, Corporate Benefits bei über 800 Marken

Über Thorit

Thorit ist die AI- und CRM-Beratung für das agentische Unternehmen. Als Diamond HubSpot Partner arbeiten wir mit B2B-Kunden im DACH-Markt: Wir bauen die Agenten-Ebene auf HubSpot und den umliegenden Systemen auf – und betreiben sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden. Was wir dort empfehlen, wenden wir auch intern an: weniger Handarbeit, mehr Struktur. Diese Rolle ist ein zentraler Teil davon.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deine Bewerbung – Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wenn du magst, schreib uns ein paar Sätze dazu, wie du schon einmal eine unaufgeräumte Buchhaltung in Ordnung gebracht hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als jede Formulierung im Anschreiben – wir fragen sonst im Gespräch danach.

data.title: GTM Engineering Working Student
data.description:
Companies have invested billions into ERP systems. And yet, most business decisions are still made the way they were in 1995: on fragmented data, manual exports, and Excel. Finance teams spend five to ten days every month copy-pasting numbers, and four systems show four versions of the same revenue.

AI changes that. At ARC, we are building the AI-native Finance OS: one platform that connects all of a company's systems, answers any question in seconds, finds errors before they cost millions, and automates reporting end to end. Leading Mittelstand companies like Burmester, Pfanner, and Ferrotec, and PE firms like AUCTUS and GENUI, already run their finance on ARC. Finance software is being rebuilt from the ground up this decade, and we intend to win the category.

We are a small, AI-native team in Berlin, fresh off our seed round led by 42CAP, growing revenue 10x since our pre-seed. We build, experiment, and move fast, take real ownership, and keep a low-ego culture.

Aufgaben

You are the GTM Engineering Intern at ARC. While our BDRs are on the phone with CFOs, you build the machine behind them: the automations, data pipelines, and AI workflows that decide who we call, with what message, and when. We sell an AI-native platform, so our own go-to-market has to run AI-native too. You'll build our internal GTM OS from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Build automated prospecting pipelines: sourcing multi-entity Mittelstand groups and PE-backed companies that fit our ICP, at scale
  • Enrich accounts and contacts with the signals that matter to us: legal entities, ERP landscape, PE ownership, trigger events like ERP migrations or acquisitions
  • Automate outreach workflows across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and keep them personal enough that a German CFO actually responds
  • Connect and orchestrate our GTM stack (HubSpot, Aircall, enrichment and outreach tools) into one system with clean data flowing through it
  • Use AI models aggressively: for research, list building, message drafting, call analysis, and anything else that removes manual work from the pipeline
  • Build dashboards and KPI tracking so we always know what's working in outbound and what isn't
  • Prototype, test, and iterate: your experiments directly shape how ARC's GTM engine works as we scale the sales team

Qualifikation

What makes you a great fit

  • You love building things: with no-code tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents, whatever gets it done fastest
  • You're deep in the modern AI tool stack and use LLMs daily as a matter of course
  • You're analytical and rigorous with data: messy lists and broken syncs bother you until they're fixed
  • You have strong business sense and can think from the prospect's perspective, not just the pipeline's
  • You're hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work: cleaning a CRM included
  • You communicate well in English; German is a plus since our market is the German Mittelstand
  • You want to work with smart and friendly people with (self-reported) low ego
  • You want to work on-site 5 days a week in our new Berlin office

You may not be a good fit if

  • You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility
  • You're not willing to deeply understand the product and the buyer behind your automations
  • You're only interested in high-level "strategic" work
  • You think GTM engineering means setting up one Zapier flow
  • You've never built anything on your own initiative
  • You prefer working remotely
  • You prefer working with minimal collaboration
  • You want to work a 9-5 job

data.title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. 

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.


Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.


Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert:  Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück.
  • Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.
  • Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.

We've closed a pre-seed round and are already running live government pilots, with plans to expand across Europe and beyond. This is an early, venture-backed company doing work that carries weight.

About the Role

This is a founding role for our expansion across the DACH region and the Nordics. You will own how we grow here, from the first conversation through to a signed contract, building the region much as we built the UK: learning the landscape, opening doors, landing pilots and turning them into long-term contracts. You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

What you'll do

  • Own go-to-market across the DACH region and the Nordics, winning and growing contracts across government, defence and large enterprise, from first conversation through to close.

data.title: Founding GTM Engineer
data.description:
Your responsibilities

We're looking for Plato's first GTM Engineer: the person who brings RevOps to Plato as a discipline and builds our revenue engine as a product, not a ticket queue. Pipeline, conversion, and revenue per headcount are your metrics.
You're inheriting real infrastructure - HubSpot as our source of truth, a custom-built deal-scoring app, call intelligence via Grain, and company-wide AI access - but the layers underneath are still unbuilt: clean data, automated process, real forecasting rigor, AI-driven workflows. That's the job.
This is a team-of-one role that's essentially a sandbox: a direct line to the founders, a mandate to change how we work, and no playbook telling you what to build first. If you want to build the infrastructure behind a revenue engine from the ground up and see your own builds move real numbers, let's talk.
What you'll actually do:

  • Get the data foundation trustworthy: CRM hygiene, field governance, deduping, enrichment on create
  • Automate the revenue process: lead routing, SLAs, stage criteria, clean handoffs across teams
  • Build the pipeline generation stack: signal-based outbound (ICP scoring, enrichment waterfalls, orchestration) so effort goes into conversations, not list-building
  • Bring AI into daily workflows: call-intelligence automation, research agents, health/churn scoring
  • Get forecasting and reporting to a place leadership can steer from weekly
  • Make sure what you ship gets used: instrument adoption, train the team, iterate


Your qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on experience architecting a CRM like HubSpot from the ground up - how objects, properties, and data structure are set up - not just administering one that's already built
  • Practical, production experience with outbound/enrichment tooling (e.g. Clay or similar)
  • You've built with AI/LLMs - prompt design, agents, or AI-powered workflows - in real production work
  • Strong data rigor: you can read a funnel, spot where the data is dirty, and quantify the impact of a fix before you build it
  • You think in systems and sequencing, not tickets - and can defend your reasoning under real pushback

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience as an early GTM-Ops/RevOps hire at another startup
  • Familiarity with our stack or similar: Grain, Sales Navigator-style outbound tooling
  • Comfort with unit economics (CAC, ACV, payback)
  • Experience with mid-market, multi-stakeholder B2B deal cycles


Why us?

You'd be Plato's first-ever GTM Engineer - not inheriting someone else's system, but building the one that doesn't exist yet, and introducing RevOps as a discipline at a company that's never had one. A direct line to the founders, real budget for tooling, and a mandate to change how the revenue team works, from day one. 
This is an individual contributor role today - you'll be doing the building yourself, not managing a team. If this function grows as Plato scales, you'd be the one shaping what it becomes, not stepping into a structure someone else already defined.
Because the function touches everything - data, process, automation, AI - you won't be boxed into one lane. If you want to see your own build move a real number within your first 90 days, this is that role.

data.title: Working Student / Intern: Offensive Security Engineer (Red Team & AppSec) (f/m/x)
data.description:
Cologne, Germany (Hybrid)

Team: Engineering · Reports to: CTO · Format: Working Student (16–20h/week) or Internship (3–6 months)

Join our red team

ilert is a SaaS platform for alerting, on-call management and incident response that keeps digital services always on. Teams worldwide rely on us to stay up.

To keep it that way, we are building an internal red team that continuously tests our own products the way a real attacker would. And we're a genuinely interesting target: an attacker who silences ilert doesn't just steal data — they turn off the alarm while they work.

As a working student on our red team, you help us find, prove, and get security issues fixed in our own systems. You learn to think like an attacker, working closely with our team.

You don't need to arrive as a finished pentester. You need curiosity, a habit of taking things apart to understand them, and the care to handle what you find responsibly.

Tasks

  • Test Our Apps and APIs: Hunt for vulnerabilities in our web and mobile apps and APIs — from authentication and access control (IDOR) to injection, misconfigurations, and exposed secrets.
  • Re-test Past Findings: Go back over findings from previous penetration tests and verify the fixes actually hold.
  • Automate Security Checks in CI: Help build secret, dependency, and code scanning into our pipelines so issues surface early instead of late.
  • Review New Features Before They Ship: Support security reviews as features are being built, not after.
  • Run Authorized Social Engineering: Design and run phishing and pretexting exercises against our own team — always under a written scope signed off by the CTO beforehand, always debriefed as a learning exercise, never punitive. Then help us fix what the exercise exposed.
  • Poke at the AI: We're building an AI SRE that investigates incidents and can execute actions on approval. Prompt injection, tool abuse, and agent-boundary testing are wide-open ground.
  • Document and Follow Through: Write up findings clearly and reproducibly, then follow them through to a fix. We care as much about closing the gap as finding it.

What you bring

  • Enrolled student, ideally in computer science, IT security, or similar.
  • Genuine interest in offensive security — you tinker, you break things to understand them, maybe you already play CTFs / Hack The Box / TryHackMe.
  • Basic grasp of how web apps and HTTP work — requests, headers, auth, cookies/tokens.
  • Comfortable on the command line and with at least one scripting language (Python, JS/TS, Go).
  • Careful and responsible with sensitive information. This role comes with access and trust: you stay inside the agreed scope and handle what you find responsibly.
  • Fluent English (our working language).
  • Able to be in our Cologne office regularly — the role is hybrid, not remote.

Bonus

  • Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP
  • OWASP Top 10
  • AWS / Kubernetes / CI-CD exposure
  • Mobile app testing
  • LLM and agent security — prompt injection, tool-use boundaries
  • Your own CVEs or bug-bounty reports
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • 🎯 A Real Attack Surface: Not a lab, not a CTF box. Production software that companies worldwide depend on during their worst moments.
  • 🧨 Get In Early: The red team is being built right now. You're not inheriting someone else's checklist — you help shape how we do this.
  • 🤖 Unexplored Ground: Agentic AI security is barely a discipline yet. You'd be doing original work on it, on a product that's actually shipping.
  • 🏡 Hybrid Freedom: Our office in Cologne Rheinauhafen (3 days/week) plus work from home (2 days/week).
  • 🕒 Student-Centric: Flexible hours around lectures and exam periods.
  • 🎓 Direct Mentorship: You report to the CTO and work alongside experienced engineers who want to be shown where they got it wrong.
  • 🌴 Focus Culture: We protect maker time, favor async, and keep meetings rare.

We hire for curiosity and a builder's mentality, not a checklist. If you have a writeup, a CTF profile, a disclosed vulnerability, or a tool you built — bring it. But if you're early and hungry and can show us something you took apart, we want to hear from you too.

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

As our Founding Account Executive in the UK at Rillet, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming how high-growth companies run their finances. Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

What You'll Do

  • Build the GTM playbook
    You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.


Who We're Looking For

  • 4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close. Experience with ERP is a plus.

  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.

  • Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.

  • Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.

  • Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

  • Previous experience as a Founding AE is also a plus.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Vice President of Sales, EMEA

CreatorIQ is seeking a Vice President of Sales, EMEA to lead our Enterprise Sales team and accelerate our expansion across the EU. Reporting to Brian Atwood, Chief Sales Officer, this leader will be responsible for building net-new enterprise business, expanding strategic customer relationships, and developing a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in London, offering flexibility and the opportunity to play a critical role in scaling CreatorIQ’s enterprise growth across the region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, creating clear expectations, strong coaching practices, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Build and execute an EMEA enterprise sales strategy focused on net-new customer acquisition, and growth within existing enterprise accounts.

  • Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline and maintain forecasting discipline that improves accuracy, visibility, and predictability across the region.

  • Accelerate enterprise revenue growth by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and helping the team effectively engage C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • Own regional sales performance against quarterly and annual revenue objectives, leveraging qualitative and quantitative data to identify opportunities, risks, and actions necessary to drive results and compress deal cycles.

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with enterprise customers and prospects, serving as a senior commercial partner and trusted advisor throughout the full customer lifecycle.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other cross-functional teams to align go-to-market priorities, support customer growth, and strengthen CreatorIQ’s position in the market.

  • Identify opportunities to expand CreatorIQ’s presence across priority EU markets while staying close to industry trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving customer needs.

  • Uplevel the Enterprise Sales organization by improving sales practices, talent development, operating discipline, and the systems and processes needed to support sustainable growth.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 5+ years of sales leadership experience, with a focus on enterprise sales in a SaaS environment.

  • Proven success leading and developing enterprise sales teams and delivering sustained revenue growth.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and selling to large organizations.

  • Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • A strategic and commercially focused approach, with the ability to translate company growth priorities into clear regional sales plans and execution.

  • A data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, performance measurement, and sales decision-making.

  • Strong proficiency with sales tools and CRM systems, including Salesforce, and a deep understanding of pipeline management and reporting.

  • Sponsors and prioritizes responsible AI adoption, secures needed support and resources, and ensures AI initiatives deliver business value while following governance standards.

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time across EMEA.

  • Experience in marketing technology and/or the creator or influencer marketing industry, and additional European language capabilities such as French or Spanish, are a plus.

  • Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

Director, International Revenue Growth

CreatorIQ is seeking a Director or Senior Director, International Revenue Growth to build and own the marketing, pipeline, and revenue growth function across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Reporting to the VP of Revenue Marketing, this leader will be responsible for generating demand across priority international markets while serving as a strategic revenue partner to regional sales. They will work closely with enterprise sales leaders and sellers to shape go-to-market strategy for a defined set of critical accounts, create account-specific growth plans, and accelerate high-value opportunities.

The role will initially launch with support from a U.S.-based marketing team and a network of contractors. Over time, this leader will define the regional organization, hire people on the ground, and build a scalable international growth function.

This role may be based in either the UK or the Netherlands. It requires travel to London at least monthly, as well as regular travel to customer meetings, team gatherings, and field events across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, hands-on execution, strong enterprise sales partnership, and deep knowledge of the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets. They will help CreatorIQ support its initial $8M international revenue goal while building the pipeline, operating model, and team required for the next stage of growth.

The final title, Director or Senior Director, will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, leadership background, scope, and demonstrated ability to build and scale an international revenue growth function.

This is a remote role based in the UK, with travel to London approximately 1–2 times per month. The role also requires regular travel across Europe for events and occasional travel to the Asia-Pacific region.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Build and own CreatorIQ’s international revenue growth engine across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, establishing the regional strategy, priorities, operating rhythm, resource plan, and measurement framework across key markets.

  • Generate net-new demand through integrated regional growth programs spanning account-based marketing, field marketing, executive engagement, events, partner activation, seller enablement, localized campaigns, and priority-account plays.

  • Serve as the strategic revenue partner to the RVP of International Sales, regional sales leaders, and enterprise sellers, aligning on market priorities, account coverage, pipeline goals, opportunity strategy, and actions required to accelerate growth.

  • Own the growth strategy for a defined set of critical enterprise accounts, partnering with sellers to identify buying-group priorities, shape account plans, coordinate targeted marketing support, and create account-specific engagement programs.

  • Help accelerate high-value opportunities by activating executive and customer engagement, developing relevant regional messaging and proof points, supporting buying committees, and removing marketing-related barriers throughout the sales cycle.

  • Define CreatorIQ’s strongest product-market fit and right to win by country, industry, vertical, customer segment, and account type, using customer insight, seller feedback, market data, competitive intelligence, and performance signals to focus investment.

  • Bring a nuanced understanding of European and Asia-Pacific markets into go-to-market decisions, adapting strategy, messaging, events, channels, and seller support to reflect differences in buying behavior, market maturity, business culture, procurement processes, and local conditions.

  • Establish a clear operating cadence with sales around target-account selection, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, campaign performance, forecast risk, and next-best actions for priority accounts.

  • Launch the function with support from U.S.-based marketing partners and specialized contractors, creating clear ownership, processes, standards, and accountability across a distributed team.

  • Build the long-term regional organization by defining the talent plan, hiring people in priority markets, and developing a high-performing on-the-ground international revenue growth team.

  • Deliver measurable revenue impact by supporting the initial $8M international revenue goal and building future pipeline; define KPIs, review performance, share insights, and reallocate resources toward the highest-return opportunities.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS growth, demand generation, revenue marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, or go-to-market leadership, with a demonstrated record of creating pipeline and revenue impact across international markets.

  • Significant experience partnering directly with enterprise sales leaders and sellers in complex B2B sales environments, with a strong understanding of long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, account planning, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity progression.

  • A demonstrated ability to both generate net-new demand and influence the acceleration of complex enterprise opportunities, with clear accountability for pipeline creation, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes.

  • Experience working on a named-account or strategic-account basis, including account selection, buying-committee strategy, executive engagement, opportunity reviews, account-specific campaigns, and coordinated pursuit plans.

  • Deep familiarity with the commercial and cultural nuances of European and Asia-Pacific markets, with the ability to adapt go-to-market strategy by country and region rather than apply a single global playbook.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional growth function, including evaluating product-market fit, prioritizing countries and customer segments, and translating market strategy into executable programs.

  • Hands-on expertise across integrated growth channels, including ABM, field and event marketing, partner programs, seller enablement, executive programs, localized campaigns, and digital demand generation.

  • Experience building a new function from the ground up, including leading through contractors and shared resources initially, then hiring, developing, and scaling a regional team.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the credibility to advise, challenge, and support sales leadership as a true revenue partner rather than simply respond to campaign requests.

  • An analytical, highly collaborative, and culturally aware leadership style, with excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Comfort operating across time zones, ambiguity, distributed teams, frequent travel, and a fast-moving global environment.

  • Based in the UK or the Netherlands, with the ability to travel to London at least monthly and regularly attend customer meetings, partner engagements, team gatherings, and field events across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Build and ship new product features end-to-end

  • Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

  • Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

  • Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

  • Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

  • Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps.

 

What you'll need

 

  • Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

  • Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

  • Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

  • Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

 

What you'll get

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.


About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

    Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.
