data.title: Senior Customer Lead National Security (London)
data.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact. National Security is a significant sector for Plexal’s Innovation Services business, where we enable our government clients’ adoption of new technology and create innovation ecosystems to enable their adaptation to the opportunity of disruptive and emerging technology. 
 
The Senior Customer Lead National Security is responsible for leading engagement with Plexal’s National Security clients in London and the adjacent region, building strategic partnerships to grow Plexal’s National Security business in region, evolving Plexal’s propositions and client offering in this market, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and success. This role sits in the wider National Security and Defence team, supporting the whole lifecycle of client engagement and delivery.  
 
The successful candidate will combine commercial capacity with government insight, helping Plexal to understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.


What You'll Do

  • Act as account lead for Plexal’s National Security clients located in London and the wider region, ensuring strong, resilient partnerships through the whole life cycle of Plexal’s client engagement from prospecting, proposal development, opportunity identification, and customer satisfaction in project delivery. Demonstrate highly visible presence with existing clients to augment Plexal’s brand and reputation.
  • Utilise engagement on client delivery to build highly effective client relationships that support Plexal’s account objectives. 
  • Drive net-new business in the customer base, leading a campaign of revenue diversification to broaden Plexal’s engagement across the client business units, and landing material value and duration contracts with the customer base.
  • Expand partnerships with the NS sector supplier base to deliver new revenue opportunities through partnership and new routes to market for Plexal.
  • Work alongside the wider NS and Defence team to develop, refine and market new propositions to Plexal’s NS clients, ensuring that Plexal is able to meet customer requirement and adapts to new opportunities in the NS market.
  • Contribute to the strategy and delivery of the NS & Defence team, providing expert insights into customer needs and procurement trends, and supporting NS&D strategic campaigns across the waterfront of client delivery.  
  • Be a valued contributor to the evolution of Plexal’s GTM function, supporting process improvements and maturation of business development.


Your Skills

  • Able to operate autonomously as an individual contributor, delivering against GTM objectives and targets. 
  • Accountable for personal delivery, and able to work collaboratively in a wider GTM team contributing to overall NS&D objectives. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, able to develop rapport and strong relationships with clients, understand client needs and align Plexal to deliver against them.
  • A strategic thinker, able to understand long-term trends in clients and develop credible Plexal propositions. 
  • A collaborative worker, with a strong bias to supporting and enabling broader teams (both GTM and London-based Plexal colleagues). 


Your Experience

Essential: 

  • Proven track record of selling, winning new business and proposition development in National Security
  • Demonstrable experience of working directly with National Security clients, especially those located in London, including demonstration of client delivery and relationship-based sales
  • Extant, valid SC (essential), DV (preferred). NS sponsorship preferred.
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of NS sector procurement and commercial processes.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
Desirable:
  • Experience of working on technology adoption, innovation ecosystems, or organisational change in government, especially National Security.
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 


Who You Are

Due to the nature of this position, our work and our client engagements, the post holder must be willing and eligible to achieve a minimum of SC clearance. Pre-existing SC clearance is welcome.


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

About the Team

You will own month-end close and balance sheet integrity across our global entities while acting as the primary internal liaison for our external accounting, payroll, and EOR providers. Additionally, you will champion our finance automation program, transitioning the team from manual workflows to highly scalable, controlled processes.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own the month-end close across multiple entities, managing journals, accruals, reconciliations, and reporting strictly to the group timetable.
  • Own balance sheet integrity, with a specific focus on payroll and employment costs.
  • Act as the internal client for outsourced accounting, payroll, and EOR platforms. Review output, hold them to SLAs, and review/approve payroll across our US, UK, Spanish, Latvian, and EOR entities to meet statutory deadlines.
  • Prepare and post payroll/employment cost journals into the ERP, ensuring data integrity between our HRIS and payroll providers.
  • Provide detailed analysis and actionable commentary on Operating Expenses and other critical areas of the P&L.
  • Lead the charge on documenting and improving workflows. You will transition manual reviews into risk-based, threshold-driven controls.
  • Support annual audits and statutory reporting alongside our auditors and outsourced providers.

 

What You Must Have

  • 5+ years in a hands-on accounting role within a SaaS or tech company, including payroll accounting processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations), month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations across multiple entities.
  • Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or equivalent), or qualified by extensive relevant experience.
  • Experience acting as the internal client for external accounting, payroll, or EOR providers — reviewing their output and holding them accountable for accuracy and compliance. A strong accounting foundation is important, alongside experience working with one or more of these provider models.
  • Solid working knowledge of multi-country payroll and payroll-to-GL processes (journals, accruals, and control account reconciliations).
  • Accounting ERP experience and highly advanced Excel/Google Sheet skills.
  • Comfort leveraging AI and automation tools in your day-to-day work, proactively exploring how AI-driven workflows can reduce manual effort and improve controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience with EOR providers (Oyster, Deel, Remote, Papaya).
  • Experience migrating to or implementing a cloud ERP.
  • Experience with Rillet, Ramp, Stripe or Xero.

data.title: Payment Operations Lead
data.description:
Payment Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for a Payment Operations hire to own the part of Outpost where the money actually moves.

When we become the legal reseller in a market, we take the payment. Every merchant we onboard gets its own merchant ID and its own merchant category code, never pooled into one shared code, which is exactly why our approval rates beat the alternatives. Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

This is a quantitative role in an operational seat. You'll live in the transaction data: why authorisation rates differ by market, issuer, card type and hour of day, what a routing change is actually worth, where a 40 basis point cost difference is hiding, which decline codes are recoverable and which are noise. Then you'll act on it, with processors, with engineering, and with merchants.

You won't be siloed. Payments at Outpost touches pricing, treasury, tax and the product roadmap, and you'll be pulled into all of it. But your edge is the numbers, and we want someone whose first instinct on any problem is to pull the data and model it.

You'll work directly with the founding team and with engineering, who will build what you spec.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

You'll own economics that decide whether the company is profitable, negotiate with processors and banks as a principal rather than a customer, and get to see the full machinery of cross-border payments from the inside. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Build the system

  • Run payment operations agentically. Build agentic system that monitor approval rates, triage declines, assemble dispute evidence, chase reconciliation breaks and draft the processor follow-up, so humans only touch the exceptions. You'll design the workflows, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce

  • Write the playbooks: new processor onboarding, new market launch, incident response, dispute handling

  • Onboard new processors, banking partners and local acquiring as we launch new markets

Own payments performance

  • Own approval rates by market, processor, issuer, card type and merchant, and know why each one moves

  • Build and run routing logic. Decide what goes where, prove the uplift, and iterate

  • Run decline recovery: retry logic, network tokens, account updater, 3DS strategy and exemption handling

  • Run chargeback operations and fraud strategy. Set thresholds, represent disputes, keep merchants inside scheme limits

  • Own the payment incident path. When authorisations drop in one market at, you're the one who spots it and fixes it

Own the economics

  • Build full visibility into cost per transaction: scheme fees, interchange, processor margin, FX, and where each one leaks

  • Own processor relationships day to day. Performance reviews, pricing negotiations, new partner evaluation

  • Model the trade-off between approval rate and cost by market, and make the call

  • Feed real payment economics into how we price merchants

Own the money movement

  • Settlement, reconciliation and payouts. Every penny accounted for, every break chased down

  • Reserve logic and settlement timing by merchant segment and risk profile

  • Work with treasury on funding, FX exposure and cash timing across our local companies

💥 Example Projects

  • Take a market from a 66% approval rate to 90% or better, and prove exactly which changes did it

  • Build the routing framework that optimises approval rate against cost, market by market

  • Renegotiate processor pricing using our own volume and performance data

  • Build the cost-per-transaction model across every processor and market, and find the basis points nobody is watching

  • Debug delays in settlement and fix them across engineering, operations and the processor

  • Design reserve and settlement logic for a new merchant segment and implement it

  • Cut chargeback rate through better fraud tooling and merchant policy

  • Evaluate and onboard a new processor for local acquiring in Latin America or Asia

  • Build the payments monitoring layer so anomalies find us, not the other way round

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • A STEM or quantitative degree is strongly preferred - mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science, statistics, econometrics or similar.

  • 3 to 7+ years in payment operations, payment analytics, or a data or analytics role that moved into payments, at a processor, acquirer, or high-volume fintech (Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com, Nuvei, Worldpay, Revolut, Wise, Dojo, Airwallex or similar)

  • Strong analytical skills — advanced Excel or Sheets, experience with BI tools, and the ability to build models and run analyses independently without waiting for a data team.

  • Bonus: experience at platforms that act as the legal reseller (Global-e, Digital River, Paddle), local acquiring outside Europe and the US, interchange and scheme fee economics, or a background in data science or quantitative consulting before payments

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action. You solve, you don't observe

  • Analytically strong and commercially sharp. You quantify the opportunity before you argue for it

  • Systems thinker who still does the work. You fix the transaction, then remove the reason it broke

  • Strong EQ. Processors, banks and merchants all need managing, often at the same time

  • Exceptionally hard working. You see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos. Startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful. You can figure anything out

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV, not vague descriptions

What this role is not:

  • Not a payments strategy role without operational depth. You'll be in the dashboards daily

  • Not a pure analytics role. The analysis is the start, the change is the job

  • Not a narrow specialist seat. Payments here touches pricing, treasury, tax and product

  • Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most companies treat payments as a cost centre someone else manages. Here it is the product and the margin at the same time.

We take legal responsibility for our merchants' payments. That means a point of approval rate is real revenue for them and real evidence for us, and a basis point of cost is real profit. Very few people get to own that surface this early, with this much data and this little bureaucracy in the way.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🦾 Outpost Team

Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen and Wayflyer, and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Equity and salary in a well-funded startup

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • Chance to grow into a senior leadership role

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

🧭 Working Style

We work together in person in London 5 days a week. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.

🌎 Reach Out

Learn more

  2. Outpost founder

Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.

One set of numbers that the CEO, the board and the commercial team all agree on. And a handover from signed contract to live merchant that never drops anything.

This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting layer. You'll sit between sales, marketing, and operations, and you'll be the only person who can see the whole revenue system at once. You'll design it, instrument it, automate it, and then run it until it's good enough to hand over.

You'll work directly with the CEO, the Chief of Staff and the founding team.

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

Own the revenue system

  • Own the CRM (Attio) end to end: object model, stage definitions, required fields, hygiene, automation

  • Build the forecasting system and operationalise it with weekly pipeline review, monthly board numbers, and quarterly planning

  • Own the GTM stack: outbound sequencing, enrichment, routing, deduplication, attribution

  • Run the pipeline agentically. Build agentic system that enrich accounts, draft follow-ups, surface stalled deals and keep the CRM clean, so the team spends its time on the conversations and not the admin. You'll design the workflows, write the prompts, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce

  • Build the reporting the company runs on, and the pack investors see

  • Hire behind you once the system is running

  • Instrument the full funnel from LinkedIn and outbound through to closed won, and prove which channel actually pays

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need — tax, payments, treasury, or operations — and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We operate across 58+ tax jurisdictions for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack — payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for our Head of Operations: the person who owns how Outpost actually runs.

Today, operations at Outpost is a set of processes held together by a small group of very good people. Merchant onboarding, KYC/KYB, market launches, tax registrations, payouts, treasury approvals, chargebacks, merchant support — it all works, but it works because people push it. Your job is to turn that into a machine.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a management layer. You'll own the operational stack end to end: onboarding and activation, merchant operations, payments and treasury ops, compliance monitoring, and new market launches. You'll design the processes, build the tooling requirements with engineering, write the playbooks, and then run them yourself until they're good enough to hand over.

You'll hire and grow a small team behind you, but for the first stretch you are the team. If your instinct when something breaks is to open the dashboard and fix it rather than schedule a meeting about it, you'll do well here.

You'll work directly with the CEO and founding team, and you'll have a real say in what Outpost builds — operations is the sharpest source of product signal we have.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return, you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10–20 years to access.

You'll own a core function of a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, work with senior stakeholders across PSPs, banks, tax authorities and merchants, and build a team from scratch. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the operational stack

  • Own merchant onboarding end to end: applications, KYC/KYB, risk review, activation, time-to-live

  • Run merchant operations day to day — support escalations, payouts, settlements, disputes

  • Own treasury operations: proceeds requests, money movement, reserves, reconciliation

  • Monitor merchant risk and compliance thresholds (chargebacks, fraud, refunds) and act before they become losses

  • Own payment operations alongside engineering: auth rates, routing, decline recovery, chargeback and fraud strategy

Build the system, not just the output

  • Turn manual processes into documented, repeatable, measurable playbooks

  • Define the operational metrics that matter and build the reporting so the company can see them

  • Work with engineering to spec and prioritise internal tooling — you are the customer for our internal ops platform

  • Kill work: automate, template, or delete anything that doesn't need a human

  • Make Outpost able to double merchant volume without doubling ops headcount

Launch and scale

  • Launch new markets with full legal, tax, payments, and operational setup

  • Onboard new PSPs, banking partners, and local acquiring in new geographies

  • Build the operational side of new products and merchant segments before they go live

  • Feed market and merchant reality back into the product roadmap

Lead

  • Hire, onboard, and grow a small operations team

  • Set standards: what good looks like, how fast we respond, what we never get wrong

  • Be the operational voice in company planning — what we can support, when, and at what cost

💥 Example Projects

  • Redesign merchant onboarding to cut time-to-live by 50% without weakening KYB

  • Build the operational launch playbook for three new markets and run the first one yourself

  • Debug delays in payouts and fix them across engineering, ops, compliance, and PSPs

  • Design reserve and settlement logic for a new merchant segment and implement it

  • Build the ops metrics dashboard: onboarding funnel, time-to-live, ticket volume, payout SLA, chargeback rate

  • Cut chargeback rate through better fraud tooling and merchant policy

  • Spec the next version of our internal ops tooling with engineering and ship it

  • Write the merchant VAT compliance playbook across EU markets with the tax team

  • Has owned a function or a large slice of one — onboarding, merchant ops, payment ops, or risk ops — not just executed within it

  • Experience building processes from zero, not inheriting them

  • Bonus: MoR platforms (Global-e, Digital River, Paddle), cross-border tax exposure, or PSP/acquirer operations

  • Comfortable with data — SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards. You measure before you decide

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action — you solve, not observe

  • Systems thinker who still does the work — you fix the ticket and then remove the reason it existed

  • Analytically strong — you can quantify a process, not just describe it

  • Strong EQ — you know how to read a room, a customer, or a blocker

  • Exceptionally hard working — you see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos — startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful — you can figure anything out

  • Comfortable getting hands dirty — your default mode is to do, not delegate

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV (not vague descriptions)

What this role is not:

  • Not a people-management role where you run a team that does the work

  • Not a process-maintenance role — nothing here is finished

  • Not a single-function specialist who wants to stay in payments, or compliance, or support

  • Not someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

This isn't about maintaining processes — it's about building the operating system of Outpost from the ground up. You won't just be in the room, you'll be writing the agenda.

Operations at an MoR is not a back-office function. It is the product. How fast merchants go live, whether money arrives on time, whether we catch risk before it costs us — that's what customers buy and where our margin lives. You'll own it.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly, and we'll back you every step of the way.

AI is a key investment area for Kraken Technologies as we look to expand our existing capabilities. A crucial part of this is broadening the foundational infrastructure that enables teams across the organisation to use AI effectively and accelerate our mission.

You'll work in the Agent Safety team. We build the shared platforms, harnesses, and guardrails that enable engineering and product teams to safely, reliably, and deterministically use machine learning and generative AI agents for internal systems and workflows across the business. This is a delivery-focused team that sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and internal enablement.

  • Practical AI evaluation and safety experience: A critical understanding of LLM behaviour and experience building or using evaluation harnesses to measure output quality and reliability

  • Security and governance mindset: Experience with areas such as threat modelling, authentication and authorisation, red teaming, data-access controls, or guardrails for internal platforms

  • Cloud experience: Comfortable running services in AWS, owning reliability and scalability, and collaborating with platform, techops, and security teams

  • Clear communication and collaboration: Able to explain technical trade-offs, challenge constructively, and turn complex safety and evaluation findings into practical action

data.title: Patient Support Coordinator
data.description:
If you are brilliant with people, love solving problems and genuinely care about giving patients a great experience, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for a Patient Support Coordinator to join our growing team at Montu. This is a busy, hands-on role at the heart of our patient journey, supporting people who may be completely new to medical cannabis and helping make their experience with us as simple, smooth and reassuring as possible.

You will be speaking to patients every day, answering questions, coordinating appointments, supporting our clinicians and working across the business to get things sorted. Some days will be incredibly busy, priorities will change and you will need to think on your feet, so we need someone who takes ownership, stays calm and genuinely enjoys helping people.

The most important thing is the person. We can teach you our systems and processes. What we cannot teach is empathy, energy and the instinct to go that extra mile when someone needs your help.

If you are organised, proactive, great with people and want to be part of a team that is changing the way patients access medical cannabis in the UK, I would love to hear from you.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you’ll be a key part of the pharmacy team and play an important role in ensuring Montu patients and clinicians receive a seamless, high-quality service. You’ll be one of the main points of contact for patients, supporting them throughout their journey while also working closely with our clinical and operational teams.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Montu’s growing UK team and contribute to the development of our patient-facing operations. You’ll need to be organised, proactive and patient-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated healthcare environment.

The Patient Support Coordinator sits within the pharmacy team and requires a dynamic, patient-centric individual who is passionate about helping patients and clinicians get the best out of the service.

You’ll support the day-to-day running of the patient journey, working closely with clinicians, operations, governance, product and technology teams to ensure patients receive a smooth and professional experience.

What will you be doing?

  • Answer patient queries by telephone and email, providing clear, professional and empathetic support.

  • Schedule and coordinate patient appointments to optimise the patient experience.

  • Handle appointment payments accurately and efficiently.

  • Maintain patients’ electronic health records, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

  • Support the clinical team by:

    • Collecting patient data relating to long-term conditions.

    • Ensuring patients meet the criteria for an initial assessment in line with Montu’s inclusion and exclusion criteria.

    • Booking patients for initial and follow-up appointments.

    • Preparing for and taking minutes during multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings.

  • Support operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities.

  • Collate patient and service feedback and liaise with the Head of Governance regarding complaints and compliments.

  • Report incidents and significant events and work with the Head of Governance to support appropriate follow-up.

  • Support clinicians with operational queries and day-to-day service requirements.

  • Liaise with the Product and Tech Support teams to resolve technical issues.

  • Work closely with your line manager and the wider team to identify opportunities for service improvement.

  • Attend work-related meetings as required.

  • Maintain all mandatory training and remain familiar with company policies and SOPs.

  • Work flexibly across shifts when required.

What you need:

  • At least 2 years’ work experience.

  • Previous experience working in a healthcare environment is advantageous but not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

  • Good understanding of working within a highly regulated environment and following policies and SOPs.

  • High level of IT proficiency and confidence using multiple systems.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities and remain calm in a fast-paced environment.

  • Patient-focused, professional and proactive approach.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary.

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 37 days after one year, rising to 30 day after year 3 plus bank holidays.

  • 5% matched pension.

  • Private Health Care

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity

  • Cycle-to-work scheme.

  • Opportunities for learning, development and career progression.

  • A dynamic, collaborative and supportive working environment.

  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients’ experiences and contribute to the growth of a forward-thinking healthcare organisation.

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe and effective treatments while delivering an exceptional standard of care.

As a growing organisation, we offer a dynamic and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers, work collaboratively across teams and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Great patient care doesn't just happen in the consultation room, it starts with a well-organised, supported and connected team behind the scenes.

We are looking for a Medical Secretary to join Montu UK on a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover contract. The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Leader to manage and scale multiple product lines in the Voice, BPO, and Workforce Management space. This is a high-impact leadership role that sits at the intersection of real-time voice systems, operations research, and data-intensive platform engineering.

You will report directly to the Head of Engineering and own the engineering organization that builds the infrastructure powering Ema’s Voice AI Employees, Agent QA, auto-learning pipelines, rich analytics, and workforce optimization capabilities — all operating as scalable, multi-tenant systems deployed across global geographies.

You will collaborate with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to translate customer needs into production systems that handle high volumes of voice data, deliver real-time insights, and continuously improve through automated learning loops. As the owner of multiple product lines, you will balance roadmap priorities across Voice, BPO operations, and WFM (work force management) — ensuring each product evolves cohesively while meeting distinct customer needs.

What You Will Do

Scalable Multi-Tenant Systems

  • Architect and build multi-tenant systems that serve enterprise customers across geographies with strict data residency, isolation, and compliance requirements.

  • Design high-throughput ingestion systems capable of processing large volumes of voice data, call metadata, and operational telemetry in near real-time.

  • Make foundational architectural decisions on data stores, stream processing, and storage tiers — balancing query performance, cost, and operational simplicity.

  • Champion SOLID principles, clean architecture, and engineering rigor across all codebases — ensuring systems are testable, extensible, and maintainable at scale.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

  • Recruit, hire, and develop senior engineers across a multi-disciplinary function spanning voice engineering, backend systems, data engineering, and applied operations research.

  • Establish engineering standards, code review culture, and a strong bias toward shipping — with equal commitment to system reliability and customer experience.

  • Coach and grow senior/staff engineers into technical leaders; manage engineering managers as the organization scales.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with Product, ML/AI, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure the platform evolves in lockstep with customer needs and market feedback.

Voice Platform & Agent QA

  • Own the end-to-end engineering for Ema’s AgentQA capabilities — real-time voice pipelines, telephony integrations, and voice-to-action workflows.

  • Build and scale the Agent QA platform: automated call scoring, compliance monitoring, sentiment analysis, and coaching feedback loops.

  • Design auto-learning systems that continuously improve voice agents from production interactions — closed-loop feedback, model retraining triggers, and quality regression detection.

  • Deliver rich voice analytics: call volume trends, handle time distributions, first-call resolution metrics, agent performance dashboards, and anomaly detection.

  • Build scalable voice pipeline across geographies – keeping in mind PII, security and compliance requirements.

Workforce Management & Operations Research

  • Build WFM capabilities including demand forecasting, shift scheduling, real-time adherence monitoring, and capacity planning — applying operations research techniques to optimize workforce utilization.

  • Design and implement optimization algorithms for headcount modeling, skill-based routing, and workload balancing across multi-site, multi-timezone contact center operations.

  • Partner with ML/AI teams to integrate predictive models for call volume forecasting, attrition risk, and staffing efficiency.

What We Look For

Required

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years leading engineering teams of 8+ engineers at high-growth startups or top-tier tech companies.

  • Deep expertise in building real-time, data-intensive systems.

  • Strong foundation in data stores and storage systems: relational databases, time-series stores, columnar analytics engines, and caching layers — with the judgment to choose the right tool for the workload.

  • Experience building quality software using AI-driven tools and workflows.

  • Track record of taking products from 0→1 and iterating rapidly based on customer feedback.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns — you write and review production code and lead by example on system design.

  • Experience building scalable multi-tenant SaaS platforms with data isolation, geo-distributed deployments, and compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Track record of building ingestion systems for high volumes of load — event-driven architectures, stream processing (Kafka, Flink, or equivalent), and batch/real-time hybrid pipelines.

  • Strong product sense: ability to deeply understand customer problems in contact center, voice, and workforce domains and translate them into clean technical solutions.

  • Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain high-caliber engineers across multiple disciplines in competitive markets.

Good to have

  • Experience in voice/telephony systems: WebRTC, SIP, voice-over-IP infrastructure, or contact center platforms.

  • Background in operations research or optimization: scheduling algorithms, linear/integer programming, constraint satisfaction, or demand forecasting models.

  • Experience building analytics platforms: OLAP systems, real-time dashboards, metric computation engines, or BI infrastructure.

  • Prior work on auto-learning or continuous improvement systems: feedback loops from production data, automated retraining pipelines, or quality monitoring systems.

  • Experience with AI/ML-powered products in enterprise settings — agentic automation, LLM orchestration, or AI-driven UX.

  • Familiarity with WFM or contact center operations — staffing models, Erlang-based capacity planning, or real-time adherence systems.

Why Ema

  • Build at the intersection of Voice AI, operations research, and enterprise-scale systems — a rare combination of deeply technical challenges with direct customer impact.

https://www.immersivelabs.com/company/our-story

Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Red Team

Immersive is hiring! Could you be our next Senior Cyber Security Engineer?

Due to customer demand and increasing maturity within our platform we have an exciting and challenging opportunity for an experienced cyber professional within the offensive security sector - with expertise in conducting red team engagements - to join our Product team as Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Red Team.

If successful you will join our Cyber team working closely with our Cyber Team Leads as we embark on this exciting new phase of product development within our market leading cyber resilience platform.

This isn’t an ordinary red team role - we know everyone claims this and will tell you their role is super unique…but this one really is.

You are constantly researching, learning, totally geeking out on all things offensive security related, from red teaming, to the latest AI driven attacks, and then taking that knowledge and creating labs and ranges.

You will be a key player in our Red Team Content team, shaping and influencing the roll out of our offensive security and AI pen test content roadmap, simulating attack paths and helping train our users to counter the latest threats.

You will be educating the world of offensive security professionals on how to make sure they are secure in what they do. Now that is a pretty cool legacy to leave behind.

Your mission (if you choose to accept it) is to evolve and disrupt within the Red Team space by creating emulated environments within our platform that will simulate both hacking and defending in an engaging and intuitive way for our community.

You will design, build and deliver practical and theory content to gamify offensive security and make it engaging and fun for the end user. You'll shake up traditional training and teach complex concepts in an innovative way.

If you have a passion for cyber security, are experienced in the area of offensive security, and want to disrupt how employees build their resilience against the latest threats we will appreciate your input and give you the space to innovate within our market leading platform, Immersive One.

Your main responsibilities (we're scaling fast, so these may change as we grow):

  • Utilising knowledge of pen test and red teaming engagements and techniques to plan, write and improve offensive security labs, challenges and online learning content on the Immersive One platform.

  • Produce multi-format content utilising various teaching methods; practical exercises, questions & gamification

  • Test Red Team labs and ranges to ensure they function as expected

  • Research vulnerabilities, tools and offensive tactics and compile this research to deliver practical and theory labs to users

  • Compile technical research into understandable concise content for both technical and non-technical audience

  • Work with the wider Product team on new projects and product innovations and how best to deploy them

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas:

  • A number of years of experience working in offensive security as a penetration tester or as a Offensive Security Consultant

  • In-depth knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and how it is used to help enterprises deal with threats to their organisation.

  • Have a strong technical understanding of networking, computing and cyber security concepts

  • Have the ability to use examples and analogies to simplify complex subjects - your content will train real world users to identify and combat the latest threats so you need to be able to inhabit the mindset of your target audience to create realistic simulations

  • Familiarity with Linux, Docker and Python would be beneficial

  • Attitude and approach is just as important as technical skills for this role - you will be someone who enjoys tackling complex problems and finding the solution. You'll be a natural problem solver and 'tinkerer' who enjoys prototyping and iteration.

Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

  • Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

  • Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

  • Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

  • One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work. Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

What is Jedox?

Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.

Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management.


Your Responsibilities

As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success.

We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here.   • Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features.

  • Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners.
  • Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities.
  • Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success.


Your Profile

  • Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function.
  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions.
  • Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together.

data.description:
Über Recare

Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie. Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen. Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter – und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen.

Das erwartet dich als unser Working Student (m/w/d) Bid & Tender Management:

  • Arbeit mit Purpose – Deine Tätigkeit hat positiven Einfluss auf Patientinnen und Patienten, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen.

  • Unternehmenskultur – Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die eine hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Wir pflegen einen Umgang, der von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt ist, und streben gemeinsam nach unseren Zielen und erwarten das Gleiche von dir.

  • Flexibilität – Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten. 

  • Edenred-Karte – die du nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.

  • Zusatz-Urlaubstag – Damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst, hast du ihn frei.

Deine Rolle als Working Student (m/w/d) Bid & Tender Management:

Im Bid- & Tender-Management unterstützt du unser Team dabei, öffentliche Ausschreibungen und Förderprojekte zu identifizieren, aufzubereiten und voranzutreiben. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Bid-Verantwortlichen zusammen, übernimmst eigenständig Recherche und Strukturierung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen sauber, vollständig und fristgerecht vorliegen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du beobachtest Vergabeportale und Förderprogramme und identifizierst relevante Ausschreibungen

  • Du übernimmst die Recherche und entscheidungsreife Aufbereitung von Förder-, Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen

  • Du pflegst unsere Tender-, Förder- und Wissens-Hubs in Notion

  • Du unterstützt bei Bids: Vorprüfung von Vergabeunterlagen, Vorbereitung von Surveys und Entwürfen, Koordination von Fristen und To-dos

  • Du dokumentierst und stellst hohe Datenqualität in unseren zentralen Systemen sicher


So stellen wir uns dich als unseren Working Student (m/w/d) Bid & Tender Management vor:

  • Du bist aktuell in einem relevanten Studiengang immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsökonomie/-management, Public Management, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Philosophie)

  • Du recherchierst und analysierst sicher und arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig - und hast dies bereits in einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder einem Praktikum unter Beweis gestellt

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, gewissenhaft und eigenmotiviert – mit echtem Engagement und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Du denkst kritisch mit, hinterfragst Aufgaben und deine eigenen Ergebnisse und prüfst lieber einmal zu viel als zu wenig

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2)

Nice-to-haves - womit du uns zusätzlich überzeugst: 

  • Idealerweise bringst du Affinität zu Notion (oder ähnlichen Tools) und ein Grundverständnis für KI-Tools mit

  • Interesse an Healthcare, Public Sector, Vergabe und Fördermitteln ist ein Plus

data.title: Inhouse Technical Recruiter (temporary contract for 1 year) (f/m/d)
data.description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Your role

We are looking for an Inhouse Technical Recruiter (f/m/d) to join our People team for 12 months. You will identify and attract the best talent for technical/engineering roles, as well as consistently build up a talent pool. You will support our hiring managers in finding innovative ways to improve our recruitment process, and develop sourcing strategies that best meet our needs. You will represent Munich Electrification authentically on relevant platforms, using your creative communication skills to attract and engage the most talented candidates.

Your future tasks at a glance

  • Manage and execute the full recruitment cycle (sourcing, arranging interviews, CV screening, interviewing…) for a variety of roles and departments (particularly hardware and software development).

  • Be on site in the office at least three times a week for final interviews, to organize the setup and welcome candidates. 

  • Continuously work together with the Hiring Managers and Department Leads to understand our recruitment goals and define the ideal candidate profile.

  • Independently develop and execute the sourcing strategy (market mapping, search criteria, etc.) for our roles.

  • Active sourcing on a daily basis to identify and attract passive suitable candidates, inspire them and gain their interest in our roles and company.

  • Consistently promote our roles on relevant social media channels (and other employer branding activities).

  • Build a strong network of qualified engineers in the fields of electronics, e-mobility and software development.

What you bring with you

  • Completed university studies.

  • Strong active sourcing and recruiting background for technical/engineering profiles in the automotive industry e.g., electronics, e-mobility, embedded software development.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize and execute without compromising quality.

  • Excellent verbal and written (selling) communication skills in English, German is a plus.

  • Charismatic and engaging, able to build and maintain strong relationships.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and is adaptable to change.

  • Having a good network within the automotive/engineering/tech. industries is a strong plus.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

data.title: Founder Associate (Berlin)
data.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About the Role

As our Founder Associate, you sit in the founders' office and work directly with the founders and Chief of Staff to shape and execute the initiatives that drive Prior Labs' growth. You get real ownership of business functions, with broad exposure across the company, from strategy to execution.

We run our business functions with defined areas of ownership: Growth, Sales & Enablement, Marketing & Community, and People Ops. You pick up ownership across these areas based on what the company needs and where you're strongest, and you go deep where you have the most impact.

Everything we do is AI-first, so you'll spend less time on the grunt work and more time building the systems that make it obsolete.

Core Areas of Impact

Below are examples of what you could own:

Growth

Leads that reach Prior Labs get qualified, enriched, scored, and routed automatically. You own that engine, make it better, and find the next channel.

  • Own the inbound pipeline end to end

  • Remove the manual steps that are left: better scoring, smarter routing, more automation

  • Build the pipeline reporting the founders and sales team actually use

  • Test new channels: data sources, outbound angles, our first paid experiments

  • Own tracking and attribution, so we know where pipeline actually comes from

Sales Enablement

Our sales team talks to some of the largest companies in the world. You build everything around their conversations so they can focus on selling.

  • Automate call prep: short briefings so no one walks into a call cold

  • Own decks, case studies, battle cards, and demo assets

  • Keep POCs on track: milestones, follow-ups, next steps

  • Turn closed deals into reference stories and case studies

Ops & Automation

We think most internal work can be automated with today's AI, and your job is to do it.

  • Pick the most annoying recurring workflow each month and automate it

  • Build agents and automations across our stack: HRIS, CRM, Notion, Slack

  • Own the internal tooling landscape: what we use, how it connects

  • Prototype fast: a working script this week over a perfect system next quarter

  • Ship things the whole company uses daily

Expansion & People Ops

We're doubling headcount across 2 countries, and everything behind that is being built right now. If you're obsessed with people, culture, and process building, this is your playground.

  • Help open our new offices and set up new countries

  • Own onboarding end to end, from signed contract to a solid first week

  • Take clunky people processes, redesign it, ship it

  • Make our HRIS the single source of truth, with automations doing the boring parts

  • Run the operational side of hiring: scheduling, candidate communication, interview logistics

What We're Looking For

You're a resourceful, adaptable, and self-driven builder who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. We're looking for someone with the potential to grow into a future leader of the company. You have:

Essential Background

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, or you've done the work without the credential

  • 1-2 years of experience in consulting, venture capital, start-ups or similar roles

  • An AI-first way of working: you try new tools the moment they come out, you know where they save time, and you know where your own judgment still has to take over

  • High agency: you ship a v1 quickly, iterate, and don't wait for a brief to figure out what needs doing

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on execution

  • Structured and reliable: when you own something, it's handled

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, in English

What Makes You Special

  • Experience working in or with early-stage startups

  • You've built automations, agents, or internal tools that people actually used

  • Background in machine learning, data science, or related technical fields

  • Familiarity with open source, foundation models, or data science ecosystems

  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects or initiatives

  • Interest or experience in sales enablement, content creation, or community building

Location

  • Berlin, a global tech hub and one of Europe's most dynamic cities

  • On-site

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 30 days of paid vacation + public holidays

  • Comprehensive benefits including healthcare, transportation, and fitness

  • Real ownership from day one, with a manager who has time for you

  • An AI-first way of working, with the tooling and budget to match

  • Work with state-of-the-art ML architecture, substantial resources and a world-class team

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

data.title: Initiativbewerbung HQ Berlin (m/f/d)
data.description:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen, Finanzieren oder Verwalten. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden – mit heute über 400 Mitarbeitern deutschlandweit.

Über die Ausschreibung

Das ist keine offene Stelle. Das ist die Ausschreibung für die Rolle, die es bei uns noch nicht gibt.

Unsere besten Einstellungen im HQ sind so entstanden: Jemand hat sich gemeldet, bevor wir wussten, dass wir ihn brauchen – und wir haben die Rolle um die Person herum gebaut.

Du passt, wenn du

  • schon mal selbst etwas aufgebaut hast.

  • Verantwortung willst.

  • kommerziell denkst.

  • schnell handelst.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau sprichst (C2)

  • aus unserem Büro in Prenzlauer Berg arbeitest.

So bewirbst du dich

Wir wollen deinen CV und die Antworten auf drei Fragen, je maximal 150 Wörter:

  1. Was hast du gebaut, das ohne dich nicht existieren würde?

  2. Wo siehst du dich bei Buena?

  3. Was willst du in zwölf Monaten können, das du heute nicht kannst?

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10–20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst.

  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss pro Monat.

  • 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

  • MacBook & Studio Display, tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Wieso jetzt einsteigen

  • Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen, eng vernetzten Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren sind wir zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

  • Wir sind meritokratisch: Deine Ergebnisse werden schnell belohnt. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

  • Wir sind persönlich: Wir arbeiten aus unserem Büro und legen großen Wert darauf, einander gut zu kennen.

data.title: Immobilienmakler (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Vermietung | Werkstudent oder Teilzeit
data.description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag.
  • Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht.
  • Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund.
  • Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner. Ein Makler aus dem Team begleitet dich, gibt dir Rückmeldung und übernimmt, wenn ein Fall komplizierter wird. Fragen zu stellen ist bei uns kein Zeichen von Schwäche, sondern Teil des Jobs.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere Makler selbst. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, hat nach dem Studium eine Perspektive.
  • Du arbeitest mit Software, die es sonst nicht gibt. Unser eigenes System lpeOS bildet Prozesse ab, für die andere Unternehmen noch mit Excel-Listen und Papierordnern arbeiten.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du organisierst die Vermarktung einer Einheit. Fototermin mit unseren Fotografen abstimmen und begleiten, Exposé erstellen, Inserat veröffentlichen und aktuell halten. Beim Exposé unterstützt dich unser Marketing.
  • Du kümmerst dich um die Interessenten. Anfragen sichten und vorqualifizieren, Termine koordinieren, Besichtigungen durchführen und nachfassen. Auch dann, wenn auf ein Objekt vierzig Anfragen kommen.
  • Du bereitest die Mieterauswahl vor. Unterlagen auf Vollständigkeit prüfen, Bonitätsnachweise sichten und deine Einschätzung zu den Bewerbern abgeben. Die finale Entscheidung trefft ihr gemeinsam.
  • Du unterstützt bei Abnahmen und Übergaben: Protokolle vorbereiten, Zählerstände erfassen, Mängel dokumentieren, Schlüssel übergeben.
  • Du hältst die Daten sauber. Jeder Kontakt, jeder Termin, jeder Status im System. Das klingt unspektakulär und ist die Grundlage dafür, dass bei uns nichts verloren geht.
  • Du arbeitest den Maklern zu. Termine vorbereiten, Objektunterlagen zusammenstellen, Korrespondenz übernehmen, bei Interessenten und Dienstleistern nachfassen. Vieles davon lernst du dabei nebenbei — weil du siehst, wie ein erfahrener Makler einen Fall aufbaut.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben. Stammdaten pflegen, Unterlagen digitalisieren und ablegen, Prozesse dokumentieren. Wie viel das ist, hängt von der Auslastung ab — planbar besprechen wir das jede Woche.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu. Eine Besichtigung mit acht fremden Leuten zu führen, muss dir liegen. Perfekt sein musst du dabei am Anfang nicht.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Menschen — oder willst es entwickeln. Bei der Mieterauswahl zählt nicht nur die Bonität, und genau dieses Urteil lernst du bei uns.
  • Du bist gut organisiert. Mehrere Objekte, Termine und Fristen parallel: Wer hier den Überblick verliert, verliert auch den guten Mieter.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig. Interessenten stehen sonst vor verschlossener Tür, und das kostet uns beim Eigentümer mehr als jeder Fehler im Exposé.
  • Du fragst nach, statt zu raten — bei Kunden genauso wie im Team.
  • Du bist eingeschrieben oder suchst eine Teilzeitstelle. Die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig, kaufmännisches oder immobilienwirtschaftliches Interesse hilft.
  • Du lernst Software schnell und denkst digital.

Vorerfahrung in der Immobilienbranche brauchst du nicht. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Einarbeitung. Du läufst mit, bekommst deine Aufgaben schrittweise und arbeitest ab dem ersten Tag mit jemandem zusammen, den du alles fragen kannst.
  • Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen. Du machst keine Ablage und keine Kaffeeküche, sondern Arbeit, die im Lebenslauf etwas bedeutet und die du im nächsten Bewerbungsgespräch erklären kannst.
  • Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, bekommt eine Zukunft und nicht nur ein Zeugnis.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig — und wir sorgen dafür, dass du die Aufgaben und die Unterstützung bekommst, die dich dorthin bringen.
  • Gelebte Feedback-Kultur. Feedback ist das schnellste Werkzeug, das wir haben, um besser zu werden. Deshalb geben wir es sofort und nicht einmal im Jahr. Das gilt in beide Richtungen: Du bekommst ehrliche Rückmeldung — und wir erwarten sie genauso von dir.
  • Planbarkeit im Semester. Vorlesungszeiten und Klausurphasen stimmen wir im Voraus ab, statt sie zum Problem zu machen. Besichtigungen liegen ohnehin häufig am späten Nachmittag.
  • Modernste Ausstattung: Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, papierlos.
  • e-Mobilität inklusive: internes E-Carsharing für Termine und private Erledigungen.

data.title: Fluidic System Engineer / Architect (m/f/d)

As a full-time member of our Orbital Systems team in Munich/Germany, you will work on defining the architecture of fluidic systems for spacecraft propulsion and other functions, working closely with a multi-disciplinary team. We work on projects ranging from launcher propulsion systems to orbital refuelling systems.

We are seeking engineers with demonstrated expertise in fluidic systems. Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. We are also interested in more experienced professionals with 10+ years of experience in fluidic system architecture and leadership. The position level, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

Ideally, your experience includes:

  • Knowledge of space systems and subsystems

data.title: Staff Engineer (m|w|d) - CRM Tech
data.description:
Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer, you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences.

This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership. You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains.

You'll work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Braze, Snowflake and AWS services including Glue, Lambda and S3 in a modern cloud-native architecture. From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. When new CRM capabilities go live, you'll see the direct impact of your work in millions of customer interactions.

The position is available in full or part-time.

About your new role

  • Design, implement, maintain, and evolve reliable and scalable software systems and data flows for CRM and user engagement use cases.  

  • Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence.

  • Lead technical initiatives within and across the team to align technical solutions with business needs.

  • Drive continuous improvements across software development, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, observability, and monitoring while evaluating new technologies where they add measurable value.

  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, architecture discussions and code reviews, fostering a collaborative engineering culture focused on sustainable technical excellence.


Skills & Requirements

  • You bring extensive experience building cloud-native software systems on AWS and designing distributed, event-driven architectures using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Kafka and modern backend technologies.

  • You have deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, ETL processes and data integration, combined with hands-on experience working with technologies such as Glue, S3 and MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.

  • You are experienced with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes, and are familiar with serverless architectures, AWS Lambda and modern CI/CD practices.

  • You have a strong understanding of software quality, security and reliability, including authentication, encryption, automated testing and secure software development practices.

  • You have a proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions and aligning engineering work across teams without formal people management responsibility.

It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

data.title: Entrepreneur in Residence P&L Owner (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut. Gerade gründest du nicht — aber du willst auch nicht zurück in eine Rolle, in der jemand anderes über Preis, Team und Ergebnis entscheidet. Dann ist das hier deine Rolle: Du übernimmst eines unserer validierten Ventures und führst es als eigenes Unternehmen. Mit Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung, ab Tag 1.

Über hiiive

Wir sind eine AI-First Company mitten in Berlin. Engineering the Future of Intelligence — ROI on Controlled AI.

Wir bauen AI nicht als Demo, sondern als kontrollierte, messbare Wertschöpfung: direkt mit Unternehmen wie Vaillant, Haas Fertigbau oder Telefónica — und über unsere eigenen Software- und Service-Lösungen. Um uns herum arbeitet ein Ökosystem aus Partnern, Spezialisten und Portfolio-Unternehmen.

Wir entwickeln, validieren und skalieren neue Geschäftsmodelle selbst — von der Idee bis in den Markt, mit eigener Technologie, eigenen Daten und echten Kunden. Was an dem Punkt fehlt, an dem ein Venture trägt, ist der Mensch, der es führt. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du übernimmst ein bereits validiertes Venture und machst daraus ein Unternehmen, das eigenständig läuft: eigene Kunden, eigene P&L, eigenes Team.

Du bist kein Berater und kein Ideengeber — du bist die kommerzielle Führung. Was verkauft wird, zu welchem Preis, mit welcher Marge und von wem: entscheidest du.

P&L Ownership

  • Volle Verantwortung für Umsatz, Kosten und Ergebnis deiner Einheit
  • Pricing, Angebotslogik und Marge — inklusive der unbequemen Entscheidungen
  • Steuerung auf Zahlen statt auf Gefühl, in monatlicher Taktung
  • Reporting an die Geschäftsführung: Fortschritt, Engpässe, Learnings

Umsatz & Kunden

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz deiner Einheit — Sales inklusive
  • Die entscheidenden Gespräche führst du selbst: Enterprise-Deals, Verhandlungen, Verlängerungen
  • Aufbau eines wiederholbaren Go-to-Market-Motions statt Einzelfall-Verkäufen
  • Sobald es trägt: Aufbau des Vertriebsteams unter dir

Betrieb & Team

  • Aufbau und Führung des Kernteams — mit Zugriff auf unser Ökosystem aus Partnern, Spezialisten und Freelancern
  • Verantwortung für Delivery-Qualität: was beim Kunden ankommt, verantwortest du
  • Prozesse, die AI-first gedacht sind — nicht Prozesse, die AI nachträglich benutzen

Zusammenarbeit bei hiiive

  • Zugriff auf gemeinsame Ressourcen: Engineering, AI, Legal, Finance, Marketing
  • Austausch mit den anderen Venture-Ownern im Portfolio
  • Enge Taktung mit der Geschäftsführung

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Wir zählen keine Jahre. Uns interessiert nicht, wie lange du wo warst, sondern was du gebaut, verkauft und verantwortet hast — und wie du heute arbeitest.

  • AI-First Arbeitsmodus. Du löst Probleme zuerst mit AI und erst dann mit Headcount. Das ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have, sondern die Voraussetzung.
  • Du hast schon einmal Umsatz verantwortet — als Gründer, Geschäftsführer, Unit Lead oder in einer Rolle, in der die Zahl an dir hing.
  • Du kannst verkaufen. Nicht „Sales steuern" — selbst am Tisch sitzen, verhandeln, abschließen.
  • Du liest eine P&L und triffst danach Entscheidungen.
  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Enterprise-Kunden: Fachbereich, Einkauf, Vorstand.
  • Hohe Ambiguitätstoleranz — du brauchst keine fertige Struktur, du baust sie.
  • Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Gescheiterte Gründungen sind bei uns ein Plus, kein Makel — wenn du sagen kannst, woran es lag.

Wen wir nicht suchen

Damit wir uns beide Zeit sparen:

  • Niemanden, der vor allem eigene Ideen pitchen will. Wir bauen und validieren unsere Ventures selbst — deine Aufgabe ist es, sie zum Laufen zu bringen.
  • Niemanden für Fundraising. Wir bauen aus dem Cashflow, nicht aus Runden.
  • Keine reine Strategie- oder Analyserolle. Ein Deck ersetzt bei uns keinen Abschluss.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

Tag 1–30

Venture, Zahlen und Kunden übernommen; eigene P&L-Sicht steht; erste Kundengespräche selbst geführt

Tag 31–60

Pricing und Angebot geschärft; Pipeline aufgebaut; erste eigene Abschlüsse

Tag 61–90

Wiederholbarer GTM-Motion definiert; Plan für Team und Delivery; belastbarer 12-Monats-Case

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Echte Beteiligung an dem Venture, das du führst. Der Umfang hängt von Rolle, Timing und Beitrag ab — wir reden darüber offen im Prozess, nicht erst im Vertrag.
  • Unternehmerische Verantwortung ab Tag 1 — nicht nach der Probezeit
  • Ein validiertes Venture statt einer leeren Seite: Technologie, erste Kunden und Daten sind da
  • Zugang zu unserem Ökosystem: Enterprise-Kunden, Partner, Engineering- und AI-Kapazität
  • Der Weg vom EIR zum Geschäftsführer deiner Einheit ist bei uns der Normalfall, nicht die Ausnahme
  • Attraktives Fixgehalt plus Erfolgsbeteiligung
  • Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Wegen
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Kostenloses Gym direkt am Büro, regelmäßige Team-Events
  • Büro in Berlin, hybrides Arbeiten nach der Einarbeitung möglich

📩 Bewirb dich jetzt

Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, Kundenwachstum aktiv vorantreiben und ein Team fachlich führen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf und kurzer Vorstellung.
